notes.title: Developer's Diary #3
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Today, we want to immerse you in the fantastic world of Everwayne and share more about the project, which over the past few years has become not just a game but a part of our lives, where we pour all our efforts.

[b]So what is Everwayne?[/b]

It's a collectible card roguelike game with RPG elements, deep narrative, dynamic card battles, and unique handcrafted art.

We chose this project specifically to create a game where genre enthusiasts could truly enjoy the full spectrum of gameplay variety, their decisions, challenges, and the search for secrets.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9067WTP.gif[/img]
We're developing this game on the Unity engine, and it has undergone quite a few changes from its initial conceptual versions. The first concepts and vision of the game were laid out back in 2021. At this stage of development, we are approaching the Early Access release.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6o1kOm6.gif[/img]
Be sure to join our Discord because on July 17, 2024, exciting news awaits you.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/J9UgTDPq8k][img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2498600/extras/лачи.png?t=1717671252[/img][/url]
Thank you for being with us, let's together save the dying world of Everwayne!

notes.title: Developer's Diary #2
notes.content:
What fantasy adventure could be complete without heroes and monsters steeped in legends? Let me introduce you to the creatures, and perhaps mutants, you'll encounter while exploring the dying world of Everwayne.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946653/279b4ed6f2b7b459e874b16cc763d9824b0e1a3b.png[/img]
[h3][b]Beastman[/b][/h3]
One of the last leaders of the once-warlike race of Beastmen that once roamed Everwayne. Even the Beastman tribes suffered immense losses after the Last War. He blames not only the Eternal but also humans for everything...
Once a chief, he now crushes his enemies with a massive hammer and elemental magic. His rage transforms into scorching lightning!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IjPVIbg.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Ghost Warrior[/b][/h3]
Once an ordinary soldier in the human army, fallen in the Last War. Now he roams the battlefield seeking revenge or peace. He fights using Soul magic and his vengeance.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/u4DRu8C.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Mech Guardian[/b][/h3]
This representative of the Mechs serves the Eternal Guard and stands in defense of his fortress. A soulless machine with unwavering loyalty to its creator. In his arsenal, an electrically enhanced spear and armor. He can defeat enemies with swift strikes or by hurling his electrified spear.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kDPreIU.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Marauder[/b][/h3]
A common man who has chosen the path of easy money and food through robbing traders, peasants, and any travelers who stray from the path. His menacing club and wrist blade catch anyone off guard.

These are just a few of the enemies you'll encounter in Everwayne!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/J9UgTDPq8k][img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2498600/extras/лачи.png?t=1717671252[/img][/url]

notes.title: Developer Diary #1
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, friends![/b]

Today, we will unveil the world of Everwayne through the eyes of those called to save it. You will meet the heroes incarnated in our dreams and fantasies. After all, the first steps in creating the game definitely began with the concept and design of the main characters.

[b]Meet:[/b]
[list]
[h3][*] Veteran[/h3]
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946653/5d21b9a006cf93118dd3c1770849330e504dcf80.png[/img]
Wearing powerful armor and skilled in handling heavy weaponry, the Veteran excels both in defense and offense, a versatile hero! But the gleam of golden armor hides a dark past and regret. Will you manage to uncover the truth?
[list]
[h3][*] Owlkin[/h3]
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946653/a07cf5c590872f1acbd57951629c5a6824ada289.png[/img]
A cunning genius of the Feathered Folk, mastering three types of magic. His ambitions and aspirations are sharply focused on conducting the most important experiment of his life. Remember, the price for knowledge may be too high.
[h3][*] Wolf[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946653/563e27213f8df345a80fc0cae5828bef958abd5c.png[/img]
A beast-man on a journey of self-discovery. Nature dictates him to be an animal, to hunt and tear flesh. But something inside guides him toward the light, calling for mercy and compassion. Perhaps the Wolf doesn't know what's happening to him, but he will surely do everything possible to understand who he truly is.
[h3][*] Gladiator[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946653/6eddf0197be00e536120c3c3ede1cdc61f6f5928.png[/img]
The champion of the arena, a warrior without a past and future... Each swing of his sword is a battle for glory, and every victory becomes a legend. His strength and skill have no equals, and the gaze full of determination indicates that the Gladiator is ready to challenge fate itself for victory. And remember: the more scars on his body, the more painful to his enemies. And he has a lot of scars...

Will you dare to live only in the present, from battle to battle, and lead him to true victory?

They weren't called to be heroes, nor did they seek fame or eternal recognition. They were ordinary residents of Everwayne, whose lives intertwined with the fate of the entire world.

And now, as they face the darkness, they embark on a dangerous journey not as heroes, but as ordinary people, faced with a choice that will determine not only their own destinies but also the fate of the world. Where their adventure will lead depends solely on your decisions...

notes.title: Welcome to the Everwayne community page on Steam!
notes.content:
We aim to earn the trust of future players, so this fantasy world with unique characters is hand-drawn. Each character has their own life storyline, skills, and path filled with dangers, and of course, those who seek to end your life. Are you ready to step into the unknown? After all, you never know what ending awaits you in our roguelike game, Everwayne.
[previewyoutube=fk98WvW0xH0;full][/previewyoutube]
The journey, during which we will share updates on the game's development, has already begun, so don't forget to keep track of the updates.
